local: Ma dedaro bwe dogum, ma otota bet egom.
Atsin ngago bwien okor, ama bagadugu
Epoa ngabuna ri nan orre bet imur.
english: [[Nauru]] our homeland, the land we dearly love.
We all pray for you and we also praise your name.
Since long ago, you have been the home of our great forefathers
And will be, for generations, yet to come.

local: Ama memag ma nan epodan eredu won engiden,
english: We all join in together to honour your flag,
And we shall rejoice together and say:
